_doc: Delivery roster + capacity limits (Group D4). `deal.owner` on a CRM deal must match a member `id` here, otherwise /crm roster reports the deal as unassigned rather than silently dropping it from the load calculation. Costs are what a delivery hour COSTS the agency, not what it bills.
_currency_note: Cost rates are in ONE currency. smOS holds no FX rates, so a client whose retainer is in a different currency reports margin as null with a reason instead of inventing a conversion.

members._note: Owner-operator. max_hours is deliberately below a full-time 160 — sales, ops and the smOS build itself take the rest.
